    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies net_processing.cpp and P2P stream deserialization to reject oversized or zero-input/output transactions and blocks before allocation.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.85,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents peers from triggering unbounded memory allocations before validation rejects malformed messages. Deserialization over P2P streams now tracks a weight budget to drop transactions and blocks that exceed block weight limits early, mitigating a reported denial-of-service vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

      "evidence": "Adds benchmarks and fuzz targets dedicated specifically to the new witness deserialization rather than generic test harness infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test and benchmark additions serve to exercise and pin the new witness format, which belongs to validation rather than test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-tx.cpp only to update calls to CScriptWitness.",
      "band": "Unranked",

    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Additions to serialize.h and streams.h specifically support transaction and block witness stream budgeting.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The serialization utility additions exist solely to serve validation and p2p DoS mitigations rather than general utility improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Redesigns CScriptWitness storage and limits pre-allocation during block and transaction deserialization in src/primitives/transaction.h and src/script/script.h.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.9,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Eliminates a critical validation-time memory and CPU exhaustion vulnerability from crafted blocks. Benchmarks in the description show worst-case valid block deserialization time drops from 279 ms to 19 ms, persisted memory drops from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB, and peak memory falls from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB."
    },
